const Default = () => {
  const [files, setFiles] = useState<File[]>(createFiles());

  const removeFile = (name: string) => {
    setFiles((prev) => prev.filter((f) => f.name !== name));
  };

  return (
    <FileTags
      files={files}

    />
  );
};

        mimeType: item.mimeType,
        dataLength: item.data.length,
        isDataUrl: item.data.startsWith("data:"),
      });
    }}
    onImageDownload={async (item) => {
      console.log("Download requested", {
        mimeType: item.mimeType,
        dataLength: item.data.length,
      });

      const index = Math.max(
        0,
        demoItems.findIndex(
          (x) => x.mimeType === item.mimeType && x.data === item.data
        )
      );

      await downloadViaBlob(item, index);
    }} />;

const DismissInteraction = (args) => {
    const [warnings, setWarnings] = React.useState(args.warnings);

    return (

                setWarnings((prev) => prev.filter((w) => w !== warning));
            }}
        />
    );
};

Disabled story ok

Enabled Default Segment story ok 
const EnabledDefaultSegment = () => <Template initial={["segment"]} />;
Enabled Word Only story ok

Enabled Both story ok 
const EnabledBoth = () => <Template initial={["segment", "word"]} />;
Enabled But Empty Value Defaults Segment story ok 
const EnabledButEmptyValueDefaultsSegment = () => <Template initial={[]} />;
Externally Controlled And Disabled Toggles story ok 
const ExternallyControlledAndDisabledToggles = () => {
  const Controlled: React.FC = () => {
    const [enabled, setEnabled] = useState(true);
    const [selected, setSelected] = useState<Granularity[]>([
      "segment",
      "word",
    ]);

    // Simulate an external persistence model owned by the parent.
    const [value, setValue] = useState<Value>(selected);

    const setSelectedNormalized = (next: Granularity[]) => {
      const normalized = normalize(next);
      const nonEmpty: Granularity[] = normalized.length ? normalized : ["segment"];
      setSelected(nonEmpty);
      setValue(nonEmpty);
    };

    return (
      <TimestampGranularitiesForm
        idPrefix="timestamp-granularities-controlled"
        value={value}
        onChange={setValue}
        enabled={enabled}
        selected={selected}
        disableEnableToggle={true}
        disableSegmentToggle={false}
        disableWordToggle={true}
        onToggleEnabled={(nextEnabled: boolean) => {
          setEnabled(nextEnabled);
          setValue(nextEnabled ? (value ?? ["segment"]) : undefined);
        }}
        onToggleGranularity={(g: Granularity, isEnabled: boolean) => {
          setSelectedNormalized(
            isEnabled ? [...selected, g] : selected.filter((x) => x !== g)
          );
        }}
      />
    );
  };

  return <Controlled />;
};

    `Explaining ${invocation.type}:\nThis tool searches for relevant data.`;

    <div style={{ whiteSpace: "pre-wrap" }}>{text}</div>
  );

  return (
    <ToolInvocationCard
      invocation={{ ...baseInvocation, state: "input-available" }}
      tool={tool}
      getToolExplanation={getToolExplanation}
      renderToolExplanation={renderToolExplanation}
    />
  );
};

const Default = () => {
  const [files, setFiles] = useState<File[]>(createFiles());

  const removeFile = (name: string) => {
    setFiles((prev) => prev.filter((f) => f.name !== name));
  };

  return (
    <FileTags
      files={files}
      removeFile={removeFile}
    />
  );
};

        index,
        mimeType: item.mimeType,
        dataLength: item.data.length,
        isDataUrl: item.data.startsWith("data:"),
      });
    }}
    onImageDownload={async (item) => {
      console.log("Download requested", {
        mimeType: item.mimeType,
        dataLength: item.data.length,
      });

      const index = Math.max(
        0,
        demoItems.findIndex(
          (x) => x.mimeType === item.mimeType && x.data === item.data
        )
      );

      await downloadViaBlob(item, index);
    }} />;

Externally Controlled And Disabled Toggles story ok 
const ExternallyControlledAndDisabledToggles = () => {
  const Controlled: React.FC = () => {
    const [enabled, setEnabled] = useState(true);
    const [selected, setSelected] = useState<Granularity[]>([
      "segment",
      "word",
    ]);

    // Simulate an external persistence model owned by the parent.
    const [value, setValue] = useState<Value>(selected);

    const setSelectedNormalized = (next: Granularity[]) => {
      const normalized = normalize(next);
      const nonEmpty: Granularity[] = normalized.length ? normalized : ["segment"];
      setSelected(nonEmpty);
      setValue(nonEmpty);
    };

    return (
      <TimestampGranularitiesForm
        idPrefix="timestamp-granularities-controlled"
        value={value}
        onChange={setValue}
        enabled={enabled}
        selected={selected}
        disableEnableToggle={true}
        disableSegmentToggle={false}
        disableWordToggle={true}
        onToggleEnabled={(nextEnabled: boolean) => {
          setEnabled(nextEnabled);
          setValue(nextEnabled ? (value ?? ["segment"]) : undefined);
        }}
        onToggleGranularity={(g: Granularity, isEnabled: boolean) => {
          setSelectedNormalized(
            isEnabled ? [...selected, g] : selected.filter((x) => x !== g)
          );
        }}
      />
    );
  };

  return <Controlled />;
};

      invocation={{ ...baseInvocation, state: "input-available" }}
      tool={tool}
      getToolExplanation={getToolExplanation}
      renderToolExplanation={renderToolExplanation}
    />
  );
};
